proof_body:
by
  intro a b c x y z σ hab hbc hxy hyz
  have hf : Monotone ![a, b, c] := by
    rw [Fin.monotone_iff_le_succ]
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [*]
  have hg : Monotone ![x, y, z] := by
    rw [Fin.monotone_iff_le_succ]
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [*]
  have hup := (hf.monovary hg).sum_mul_comp_perm_le_sum_mul (σ := σ)
  have hanti : Antivary ![a, b, c] (fun i => ![x, y, z] (Fin.rev i)) :=
    hf.antivary (hg.comp_antitone Fin.rev_anti)
  have hdown := hanti.sum_mul_le_sum_mul_comp_perm (σ := σ.trans Fin.revPerm)
  have r0 : Fin.rev (0 : Fin 3) = 2 := rfl
  have r1 : Fin.rev (1 : Fin 3) = 1 := rfl
  have r2 : Fin.rev (2 : Fin 3) = 0 := rfl
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Equiv.trans_apply, Fin.revPerm_apply, Fin.rev_rev, r0, r1, r2] at hup hdown
  exact ⟨by simpa using hdown, by simpa using hup⟩
target_source: ∀ (a b c x y z : ℝ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)), a ≤ b → b ≤ c → x ≤ y → y ≤ z → a * z + b * y + c * x ≤ a * ![x, y, z] (σ 0) + b * ![x, y, z] (σ 1) + c * ![x, y, z] (σ 2) ∧ a * ![x, y, z] (σ 0) + b * ![x, y, z] (σ 1) + c * ![x, y, z] (σ 2) ≤ a * x + b * y + c * z
